data.one_liner: Dart implementation of Project Fluent for natural language localization.
data.what_it_does: Fluent is a Dart runtime implementation of Project Fluent, a localization framework designed to handle complex natural language concepts like plurals, gender, and conjugations. It uses FTL translation files and provides the FluentBundle class to format localized messages with arguments.
use_when: You want to use Project Fluent (FTL) localization files in your Dart or Flutter application.
You need advanced localization features like gender, plurals, and complex natural language formatting.
avoid_when: You prefer standard Flutter arb/l10n localization approaches.
You need full support for all advanced DATETIME and NUMBER options which are currently not supported.
strengths: Unleashes the expressive power of natural language translations through FTL files.
Supports custom functions for localized variations (e.g., OS-based text).
Recovers gracefully from formatting errors to provide human-readable fallbacks.
weaknesses: Does not yet support certain advanced options for NUMBER and DATETIME formatting.
Requires manual parsing and setup of FTL files.
